units.source_text: 伊万里 [6] 瓷盘里盛满了竹叶卷寿司。

en.t: The Imari porcelain plate was piled high with sushi wrapped in bamboo leaves.

units.source_text: 剥开包成三角形的竹叶，就看见饭卷上放着一片薄薄的加吉鱼。

en.t: When the triangular bamboo leaf wrapping was peeled open, a thin slice of sea bream could be seen resting on the rice roll.

units.source_text: 汤主要是豆皮加少许香菇。

en.t: The soup was mainly fried tofu skin with a little shiitake mushroom added.
